products.name: Firenze Cap-Toe Oxford
products.description: A clean cap-toe in deep black leather. Smart enough for the boardroom, understated enough for a wedding, and photographed in low light so you can see how the leather holds its shine.

images.alt: Black leather cap-toe lace-up shoe photographed side-on against a black background

products.name: Bologna Wingtip Oxford
products.blurb: Medallion broguing with a worn-in shine.
products.description: A black wingtip oxford with medallion broguing. Years of wear have given the leather a soft, lived-in character that brand-new shoes cannot fake.

images.alt: Pair of black leather wingtip oxfords with brogue perforations, seen from above on a white background
Black wingtip oxfords from above, showing the creasing of the leather

products.name: Siena Plain-Toe Derby
products.blurb: Warm chocolate brown for everyday wear.
products.description: A relaxed plain-toe derby in warm chocolate brown. The open lacing makes it easy to adjust, and the clean front pairs with everything from denim to tailoring.

images.alt: Pair of brown leather plain-toe derby shoes resting on white fabric

products.name: Verona Wingtip Derby
products.blurb: Full brogue detail in rich chestnut.
products.description: Full brogue detailing on a sturdy derby last, in a rich chestnut brown. A natural partner for chinos, denim and tailoring alike.

images.alt: Brown leather wingtip derby brogues with brass shoe trees on a display stand
Brown wingtip derby brogues on a display stand, side view
Brown wingtip derby brogues with shoe trees, seen from above

products.name: Napoli Wholecut Oxford
products.description: A wholecut oxford with a hand-burnished patina: amber at the centre, deeper brown at the toe and heel. The most distinctive pair in the collection.

images.alt: Hand-burnished tan and amber wholecut oxfords with cedar shoe trees, shown from above and from the side

products.name: Roma Brogue
products.blurb: Sun-warmed tan for linen and khaki.
products.description: A tan wingtip brogue with a sun-warmed colour that suits linen, khaki and lighter tailoring.

images.alt: Pair of tan leather wingtip brogues on a cream sofa

products.name: Torino Kiltie Loafer
products.description: A burgundy loafer with a fringed kiltie tongue. Dressy enough for the office and relaxed enough for the weekend.

images.alt: Burgundy leather kiltie loafer with a fringed tongue on a wooden crate in a vintage shop

products.name: Milano Oxblood Brogue
products.description: A polished wingtip brogue in glossy oxblood. The colour deepens beautifully with each polish.

images.alt: Burgundy leather wingtip brogues seen from above, standing on autumn leaves
